display_name: The PU-12M's R-111 (FuG-3, the regiment's command net) and R-407 (FuG-5, the regiment's telecode) as sets
status: First pass, 19 October 2026 (docs/research/PU12_RADIOS_2026-10.md; simcore/radio_sets.hpp). Loaded through the PU-12M console's "radios" block.
notes: Frequencies in Hz, times in s, ranges in m. The R-111's numbers come from its ТО (r111_to), the R-407's from its ТО's data (r407_to) and its instruction plate (r407_plate); the PU-12's own figures (flak11) where the sets stand in the post. What no document gives (the split of the R-111's 45 s retune, the R-407's wide band) is marked estimate.

subband_split_hz.source: r111_to (p. 6: sub-band I 20-36 MHz, II 36-52 MHz; one scale, the figures of both sub-bands on it)

power_w.source: r111_to (p. 7: at least 65 W at 20-22 MHz, 75 W at 22-28 and 50-52 MHz, 80 W at 28-50 MHz, hand-tuned); r111_refs (42-52 W with the automatic tuning)
power_w.notes: Only the fractions set the reach (the fourth root); the watts are for the EM layer and the debrief.

preset_drive_s.source: estimate (r111_to p. 6: the whole retune at most 45 s; the mechanism's share is SAM3D's split)

tune_s.source: estimate (r111_to p. 6: the whole retune at most 45 s; the power amplifier's and the tuner's share)
tune_s.notes: Half for the amplifier (its НАСТРОЙКА УМ lamp), half for the tuner (САУ); the tuner alone takes half.

range_whip_m.source: r111_to (p. 6: both on the move, the 3.4 m whip, at least 35 km); flak11 (PU12-1: the PU-12's R-111 25-30 km)
range_whip_m.notes: The NVA figure for the post is lower; its conditions are not given. The ТО's is used, by the antennas up.

range_mast_whip_m.source: r111_to (p. 6: one standing on the whip with counterpoises on an 11 m mast, the other moving, at least 45 km)

range_mast_mast_m.source: r111_to (p. 7: both on masts, at least 60 km)

separation_fraction.source: r111_to (pp. 3-4: two sets in one vehicle or nearer than 300 m at least 10 % apart, else the input protection trips)

call_s.source: estimate (the ВЫЗОВ РАДИО lamp lit while a call comes in)

duplex_offset_hz.source: r407_to (duplex with the receive and transmit frequencies 4 MHz apart); r407_plate (ПОМНИ: in duplex the receiver 4 MHz from the transmitter)

apch_hold_hz.source: r407_to (the АПЧ holds an initial detuning of the receiver of up to 15 kHz to within 3 kHz)

narrow_hold_hz.source: derived from r407_to (the second IF at least 28 kHz wide at -6 dB, the deviation 7 kHz: a detuning of 14 - 7 kHz keeps the signal in the band)

wide_hold_hz.source: estimate (the УЗКАЯ / ШИРОКАЯ toggle, r407_photos; its band is not given: twice the narrow)

wide_range_factor.source: estimate (the wide band lets twice the noise in: the reach falls to 2^(-1/4), the plane-earth fourth root)

unsettled_drift_hz.source: r407_to (the receiver's first oscillator drifts at most 5 kHz by self-heating within 15 min; the scales to 8 kHz 15 min after switching on)

range_mast_m.source: flak11 (PU12-1: FuG-5 R-407 to 15 km); r407_to (on an 11 m mast up to 20 km, on the 5 m support up to 10 km)
range_mast_m.notes: The PU-12's figure; the antenna on the post's mast is SAM3D's reading (docs/research/PU12_RADIOS_2026-10.md).

range_low_m.source: r407_to (on a lowered mast between two vehicles on the move up to 4 km)

rx_spurs_hz.source: r407_plate (II.10: the receiver's 53.8, 56.85 and 59.5 MHz not to be assigned)

tx_spurs_hz.source: r407_plate (III.5: the transmitter's 52.5, 55.55 and 58.2 MHz not to be assigned for duplex)

call_s.source: estimate (r407_plate II.8: a call lights the green РАДИО lamp with a high tone and the bell)
